div.div:
Flows
■ ①–④ Patient → CloudFront/WAF → private ALB → EHR → Aurora
■ ⑤–⑥ Remote staff → Verified Access → ALB
■ ⑦–⑨ Clinic → DX/VPN → TGW ⇄ Firewall (inspect) → HL7 engine
■ ⑩–⑪ DICOM router → TGW (inspected) → endpoint → HealthImaging → viewer
┄ Egress: firewall allow-list → NAT → IGW
┄ ⑫ Clinic DNS → Resolver (private names)
